changes.title: Final deaths stay deaths during save cleanup
changes.text: Death cleanup no longer seals a live recording as Abandoned before the final death ranking arrives. Explicit player abandonment remains distinct. Original saved games and uncertain older history remain unchanged.

changes.title: UIMSD keeps the column you were inspecting
changes.text: Sorting preserves the horizontal table position, keeps a newly selected sort statistic visible and shows its ascending or descending marker at the start of the heading. Filters, column edits and settings retain the viewport where possible. Sorting begins at the first newly ordered row.

changes.title: Recorded ascensions remain distinguishable from other wins
changes.text: New completed runs explicitly record whether the ascent was completed. Existing serialized outcome values and win-rate semantics stay compatible; older unrecorded ascensions stay unknown. Derived caches refresh automatically without changing raw logs.

changes.title: Outcome persistence and Android sort viewport regressions
changes.text: Regression tests cover final death timing, abandonment, wins, ascensions, save/load, archives, caches, filters and reports; real menu touches cover repeated Columns choices, both sort directions and viewport retention.

changes.title: Private matched developer and player APK request
changes.text: Both variants use identical game source and preserve signing, save identity and reviewed historical Changes records. No destructive outcome migration or public release.
